desc: Validate against examples, edge cases, and brute-force random instances.
Implement the top-two-boundary sweep with correct handling of ties, duplicate pairs, and exactly-one removal.
Derive and verify the sweep invariant for valid subarrays ending at each right endpoint.
Track each pair’s accumulated improvement when it is the dominant constraint.
Ensure `O(n + m)` time and space with integer-safe counting.
